descriptor.name: Dublin Tailte Éireann freehold cadastral parcels
descriptor.scope: Public Tailte Éireann freehold title parcel boundaries only; leasehold and unregistered land are outside this layer. Thirteen aligned cells around the unchanged Dublin WUP locator returned 113 unique full polygons with stable count/OID manifests, forced one-feature paging and 113 matching fresh native SP_ID reads. Root independently confirmed native lookup, explicit absence, center-cell completeness, full-parcel footprint binding and zero invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors in EPSG:2157. The WUP point is outside freehold polygons; the nearest verified parcel is 31.027 m away. Bounded evidence does not establish citywide completeness, survey precision, exclusive legal ownership or currency.
